title: Demand for riskier mortgages rises again, along with interest rates
summary: As mortgage rates continue to rise, there is a noticeable shift in borrower behavior towards riskier loan options. Specifically, many individuals are opting for adjustable-rate mortgages, which, despite their inherent risks, present lower initial interest rates compared to fixed-rate alternatives. This trend reflects a broader economic context where rising costs are pushing consumers to seek more affordable borrowing solutions. The increasing demand for these types of mortgages may signal changing attitudes towards financial risk in the current economic climate.
